appName.description: The extension's name, as the browser's extension list and the store show it. 'Rand Wallet' is the product's name: keep it as it is unless your language transliterates product names.

appShortName.description: A short form of the name (at most 12 characters), used where the full name would not fit. Normally the same as appName.

appDescription.message: 你的 Rand Protocol 隱私錢包：隱私 RAND 和代幣、私密付款、跨鏈橋提取及 dapp 授權。
appDescription.description: One sentence under the name in the extension list and the store. At most 132 characters. 'Rand Protocol' and 'RAND' (the coin) stay as they are.

actionTitle.description: The tooltip on the toolbar button that opens the wallet's popup.

sidebarTitle.description: Firefox only: the title of the wallet's entry in the sidebar menu and at the top of the sidebar.
